newsitem.title: USA: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 111.0 in June.
newsitem.headline: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 111.0 in June.

text.p: The Economic Cycle Research Institute (ECRI) monthly future inflation gauge (FIG) rose to 111.0 in June from a revised 110.8 in May, ECRI said.
Faster growth in real estate loans and industrial materials prices and a narrowing of the yield spread between 10-year notes and three-month Treasury bills, pushed the gauge up, ECRI said.

"The continued advance in the gauge affirms that inflationary pressures are still in a cyclical upswing," ECRI said. "However, the FIG has risen only 1.1 points in the last three months compared with an increase of 2.1 points in March alone," it said.
